status.label: Status
status.hint: Hidden quests are invisible to players. Any other status shows the quest to everyone.

name.label: Name
name.hint: Players see this name, even without access to the actor.

img.label: Portrait
img.hint: Shown next to the quest title and in the list.

location.label: Location
location.hint: Where it happens. Links like @UUID[…]{Nachglut} work.

description.label: Description
description.hint: What the group knows. Players see this as soon as the quest is revealed.

hook.label: Hook
hook.hint: How do the players stumble into it - without a marker?

approach.label: What the group can do
approach.hint: The goal and two or three ways to get there.

choice.label: The choice
choice.hint: Which decision without a right answer waits at the end?

reward.label: Reward
reward.hint: What does the group get - and what does it cost?

secret.label: Secret
secret.hint: Which secret of the world does it touch - and who knows: the players, the characters, nobody?

Edit.GiverHint: Drag an actor from the sidebar onto the portrait: name and image are filled in.
Edit.DropActorOnly: Only actors can be dropped here.
Edit.ObjectivesHint: Players only see revealed objectives. Optional objectives don't count towards progress.
Edit.BriefHint: Only you see this. Not encrypted yet: a player who opens the browser console could read it.

View.GiverNoAccess: You don't have access to this actor.

Keybinding.Toggle: Open or close the Quest Log
